title: NPDev browser-AI relay: ingest result
description: What `npdev ai relay ingest --json` prints for one answer brought back from a browser chat AI. The text stage (NPDevCli/npdev_relay_ingest.py) sets outcome to one of the text outcomes; when it is PARSED the CLI continues (desire-paths, validate, diff gate) and replaces it with READY or NEEDS_FIX, filling `validation` and `preview`.

reason.description: null when allowed; e.g. code, html-has-script, config-file-denied, path-traversal, absolute-path, later-phase, not-in-allowlist, executable, protected-directory, manager-owned-file

content.description: Absent for denied files: a denied file's bytes are never handed on.

prose.description: The AI's words outside the files. DISPLAY AS PLAIN TEXT ONLY (textContent), never as HTML, links not clickable.

validation.description: READY/NEEDS_FIX only: the npdev-validation-report.v2 of the composed model.

configProposals.description: Phase f4 (REG-323 T4.5): what the AI suggested about settings in npdev-config-proposal.json, one item per change. NOTHING in it is ever written to the app. `suggestion` = 'you can do that in Settings'; `refused` = a property NPDev never changes from a chat (its value is not echoed); `applicable` = an allowlisted knob (relay-config-allowlist.json: the app's theme, ui.theme.name and ui.theme.choices) with a valid value; it is applied ONLY if the owner confirms its `confirmCode` when applying, and then undone with the rest of the answer.

text.description: READY only: the sentence the Manager shows for this item, in the person's language (`preview` is always English). Wording only: nothing keys off it.

value.description: `applicable` only: the value that will be written (it passed the allowlist entry's type and values).

confirmCode.description: `applicable` only: `config:<property>`, the code `relay apply --confirm-warning` takes to apply this one change.

preview.description: READY only: the plain-language preview the Manager shows (plan 2, step 4). Built from the diff-gate report and the compiled model, never by the UI.

next.description: What the user does next. kind=copy-prompt carries the follow-up text; kind=user-action carries only a message id (the Manager's relay message catalogue).
